root_cause.observation: NIImporter_OpenStreetMap calls NBEdgeCont::extractRoundabouts after materializing OSM edges. The implementation iterates a std::set<NBEdge*> and chooses the first matching outgoing roundabout edge. Pointer ordering and first-match traversal can partition the same tagged directed graph differently between processes.
root_cause.semantic_consequence: NBEdgeCont::markRoundabouts later uses each EdgeSet to assign roundabout priority and to decide which incoming connections are outside that roundabout. EdgeSet partition changes are therefore not formatting-only.

accepted_component_classes: complete partition into directed cycles by exact edge and lane permission contract
blocked_component_classes: permission partition that does not produce complete directed cycles
node type outside priority or right_before_left
roundabout record containing an edge without OSM junction=roundabout evidence
normalization_policy.turnaround_policy: Observed turnaround connections are preserved and recorded. Their legality is audited downstream; normalization does not delete them.

case_results.exact_witness: Percy Circus has six tagged edges over seven nodes, with two dead_end nodes, so the OSM roundabout evidence does not form a closed directed cycle.
One OSM-tagged roundabout component contains a single directed edge over two nodes and cannot be completed from the available evidence.

legacy_network_comparison.interpretation: The two-stage result is reproducible but is not a local candidate repair. Full-network PlainXML reconstruction changes generated semantics throughout the network and may only be evaluated as a versioned initial-source protocol. It is forbidden in the current v1 promotion path.
